text:
You need a cross-platform React Native chat app that lets pet owners ask questions, get OpenAI-powered answers, and connect with veterinarians in one easy-to-use experience.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience, and I’d be glad to help build this. Your scope is a good fit for the kind of product work I do: user registration and login, profile and settings management, in-app messaging, OpenAI integration, search for previous answers, notifications, and a smooth flow for both pet owners and veterinarians. I can help design and implement the application so the experience stays simple for users while still supporting the different paths for automated answers and human veterinarian replies.

One relevant project I built was a streaming chat widget for Quillstack. I developed the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streamed answers token by token using React, TypeScript, Server-Sent Events, Node.js, and the OpenAI API. One result was getting the first token on screen in about 600 ms, which helped make the experience feel immediate and responsive. It also supported 30k chats a month. That work is directly relevant to your need for fast AI responses and real-time conversation flow.

For this project, I’d approach the app with a clean React Native architecture and a practical backend structure that supports messaging, authentication, veterinarian participation, and OpenAI integration. I’m comfortable working across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, and full-stack product development, and I pay close attention to UX so the app stays intuitive for both users and professionals. I can also help think through the conversation structure, message handling, and feature ordering so the app is reliable and easy to extend.

If you’d like, I can help you plan the MVP scope and map the data flow for users, veterinarians, AI answers, and notifications before implementation.
